cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent Saturday on your fence. Please don't describe that as putting up three panels; preparation is part of the job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: But there are only three panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three panels after removing the rotten posts and making two supply runs. Count the whole operation, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell them three took a full day before you mention six. I would like my Saturday acknowledged, not multiplied.

reason: Keep the original genuine credit-versus-referral mechanism but replace generic wrappers with specific preparation corrections and a direct demand to acknowledge the used day.
